Title: Wonder Woman Vol 4 10

URL Source: https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Wonder_Woman_Vol_4_10

Markdown Content:
****_Wonder Woman_ (Volume 4) #10**** is an issue of the series [_Wonder Woman_ (Volume 4)](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Wonder_Woman_Vol_4 "Wonder Woman Vol 4") with a cover date of [August, 2012](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Category:2012,_August "Category:2012, August"). It was published on June 20, 2012.

## Synopsis for "Vows"

With her wedding to [Hades](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Hades_(Prime_Earth) "Hades (Prime Earth)") soon to come, the ruler of [Hell](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Hell "Hell") forces [Wonder Woman](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Wonder_Woman_(Diana_Prince) "Wonder Woman (Diana Prince)") to place her own [Lasso of Truth](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Lasso_of_Truth "Lasso of Truth") around her neck to _prove_ that she truly loves him. Even as she confirms that she does truly love him, she breaks free of her bonds and escapes, as she will not marry him, regardless of whether she loves him or not.
